findings.title: Test hook file requires build tag the test run never sets
findings.message: The candidate patch is not applied to the repository. prepare.py patches via exact string replacement and the test files are built with a build tag (vellum_priority_test) that the test command never passes, so currentPriorityState is undefined and the tests fail to compile. The cited test run is thus unreproducible.
findings.suggestion: Pass -tags vellum_priority_test in checks.py's go test invocation, or remove the tag from priority_testhooks.go.

findings.title: Panic on override failure crashes rendering
findings.message: If the QoS override cannot be obtained, the render path panics. That crashes the application's composition worker instead of degrading gracefully, even though the override is only an optimization.
findings.suggestion: Return a no-op priority object (unlocking the thread) when the override fails, and optionally log the failure, rather than panicking.

findings.title: Panic in deferred cleanup masks errors and leaks locked thread
findings.message: If override end fails, end() panics from a deferred call and leaves the OS thread locked. If a render panic is already unwinding, this replaces it and hides the original error. Rendering would also crash on a non-critical failure.
findings.suggestion: Do not panic in cleanup. Record the error and unlock the thread, or intentionally leave it locked but avoid masking the original panic.
